title: Ghost of Whiskers Past - Vergrim Vengeance
description: Ghost of Whiskers Past - Vergrim Vengeance — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Slay Vergrim's Vengeful Soul in Vergrim's Revenge, off of The Whisker's Library - Dogma Section, slay 8 Vergrim's Vengeful Blademasters and 6 Vergrim's Vengeful Blasters, then return to the Townston Commander.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: No

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Slay Vergrim's Vengeful Soul in Vergrim's Revenge, off of The Whisker's Library - Dogma Section, slay 8 Vergrim's Vengeful Blademasters and 6 Vergrim's Vengeful Blasters, then return to the Townston Commander.

Offer:

Like the previous two ghosts, destroying the spirit unleashes their Vengeful Soul, and even though this is when they are most powerful it is also when they are most vulnerable. That is pretty much all that we know at this point, but the Townston Alchemical Association is on the verge of another breakthrough. Hopefully it will be better than their last one: a container that keeps cold potions cold and the hot potions hot. Hacks!

For now I need you to get back into Vergrim's Revenge to keep things from getting any worse. Head to Level 7 of Ratsputin's Gulag, then into The Whisker's Library - Dogma Section, then onto Vergrim's Revenge. I want you to slay Vergrim's Vengeful Soul, 8 of Vergrim's Vengeful Blademasters, and 6 Vergrim's Vengeful Blasters. When you have completed this quest return to me, the Townston Commander, here in Townston.

Turn-in:

Well done. You are biding us precious time to crack the mystery of how Ratsputin is capturing their souls. Keep it up!

Objectives:

  • Slay Vergrim's Vengeful Soul
  • Slay Vergrim's Vengeful Blademaster
  • Slay Vergrim's Vengeful Blasters

Level range: 79–100
